blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — EJ Laure-Cariño relished being in her first-ever career unbeaten run with Nxled, promising to keep stepping up in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series semifinals. Laure-Cariño continued to step up with 12 points and 13 digs as Nxled completed an eight-game elimination round sweep after beating ZUS Coffee, 25-21, 25-20, 20-25, 25-19, on Saturday at Philsports Arena. “Of course, I’m really happy because, for the first time in my career, I’ve had an undefeated run. I’m just really happy,” said Laure-Cariño in Filipino. “But we still have to work hard in training, address our lapses and improve on […]...
